title: Stack
definition: A Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) data structure. In JS, arrays can act as stacks using `push()` and `pop()`. Used for managing function invocations, undo/redo, and bracket matching.
simpleExplanation: A stack of plates. You can only add a plate to the top, and you can only remove a plate from the top.
